description: For policy acknowledgment, this checklist records required reading, training dependency, questions, disclosure or consent boundaries, acknowledgment deadline, and exceptions. Its supporting evidence includes delivery record, training completion, employee questions, accessible-format request, acknowledgment, and manager follow-up.

blocks.guidance: Identify the exact policy copy assigned for distribution.
blocks.label: Policy Assignment Reference

blocks.guidance: Identify the intended recipient and a usable delivery format.
blocks.label: Recipient and Access Needs

sections.guidance: Match the recipient to the policy copy actually delivered.
sections.title: Assigned Policy and Recipient

blocks.guidance: Leave an item open until its evidence or exception is recorded.
items: Assigned policy identifier and version match the delivered copy
Recipient received a usable language and accessible format
Required reading was completed by the stated deadline
Required training was completed or linked
Questions and exceptions were answered or routed
The acknowledgment does not substitute for consent or waive rights
blocks.label: Delivery, Reading, and Training Checks

blocks.guidance: Record dates and unresolved questions from the recipient.
blocks.label: Receipt and Follow-Up Facts

blocks.guidance: Use this record only to document delivery, reading, questions, training, and receipt. Route rights, consent, conflict, or policy interpretation questions for qualified review.
blocks.label: Acknowledgment Is Not Consent or Waiver

sections.guidance: Verify delivery, reading, training, questions, and exceptions.
sections.title: Delivery, Reading, and Training Verification

blocks.guidance: Retain the exact version, timestamp, and linked training record.
blocks.label: Acknowledgment Status and Retention

fields.label: Manager or reviewer, signature, and date

sections.guidance: Record receipt status, retained version, and linked training.
sections.title: Receipt Status and Acknowledgment

subtitle: Policy Acknowledgment Checklist: workplace policy distribution and acknowledgment using policy identifier, required reading, and delivery record.
title: Policy Acknowledgment Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during workplace policy distribution and acknowledgment when the policy acknowledgment record must identify policy identifier, version, effective date, audience, employee identity, location, language, and delivery channel. Complete the applicable handoff for acknowledgment timestamp, exception routing, overdue follow-up, version retention, training linkage, and HR record handoff.
